scope: Survey of official federal sources read in one session for a planned skill for the United States District Courts in Wisconsin. Each record says what was fetched, what its face printed about its own date, how much of it was read, and the SHA-256 of the response. The file holds no rule text and no statement of law, and nothing in it has been adopted as project legal text. A reachable address or an unchanged hash does not establish current law.
method: One request per address with at most one retry, on https only; each host's robots file requested first and obeyed; at least 2.5 seconds between requests to a host, and the host's Crawl-delay where it set one. Response bodies are kept privately and are not part of this repository.
permitted_hosts: uscourts.gov and its subdomains, uscode.house.gov, govinfo.gov and www.govinfo.gov.

hosts.note: Disallows /assets/, /forms/, /rule-procedures/ and other paths; the court's PDFs are under /assets/.
